source.title: A DNA-barcoded Luria-Delbrück assay resolves mechanisms of adaptation

metadata_date_disagreement.interpretation: Posted-date claim uses the main PDF frontmatter, visible posted banner and agreeing DC.Date/citation_date, not the disagreeing auxiliary field.

reported_system.founder_design: approximately ten cells per barcode at start, not one independently authenticated mutation event per barcode
reported_system.physical_design: pooled one-pot growth; virtual lineages computationally constructed from barcodes

calibration_and_inference.absolute_mutant_count_M: estimated by colony counting and refined during fitting
calibration_and_inference.preselection_sizes: vary across barcode lineages; computational merging justified by authors using model addition stability
calibration_and_inference.mutant_competition: authors explicitly identify fitness differences/competition as a confound that can distort barcode frequencies
calibration_and_inference.authors_reported_stability: postselection barcode frequencies stable in their canavanine context; transport to another selective context needs calibration
calibration_and_inference.code_and_data_statement: will be made available in a public repository; no named deposition in inspected main-document statement

selected_source_anchors: Analysis code and sequencing data will be made available in a public repository.

TMD_transfer_gates.required_record: Barcode uniqueness/collisions, founder membership and preselection ancestry, physical pools and disjoint versus overlapping virtual-lineage construction; an independently assessed trial/count law.
TMD_transfer_gates.boundary: Barcode/read counts are not automatically independent culture or mutation-event counts.

TMD_transfer_gates.required_record: Native exposure and absolute abundance calibrated with external standards and held separate from fitted outcomes; declared recovery, selection and classification stages.
TMD_transfer_gates.boundary: A total mutant count refined against the same endpoint cannot be silently reused as an independently frozen supply estimate.

TMD_transfer_gates.required_record: Route-, background-, marker-, density-, timing- and scaffold-matched measurements of competition/establishment and later recovery.
TMD_transfer_gates.boundary: Yeast canavanine barcode stability does not establish SBW25 WS frequency independence or transport.

TMD_transfer_gates.required_record: Orthogonal parental/new-event genotype and ancestry observations, inherited negatives, losses and detection limits; actual stocked materials and matched route definitions.
TMD_transfer_gates.boundary: A barcode labels a lineage, not every mutation birth. An undetectable barcode is not proof that no mutation arose.

TMD_transfer_gates.required_record: Versioned actual input/code/metadata/terms and independent qualified review, followed by frozen complete route predictors and untouched evaluation.
TMD_transfer_gates.boundary: The current main-document method lead does not supply an admitted matched Wsp/Aws/Mws dataset.
